`stories-bundle-overview.html` is the unmodified historical sample from
microsoft/amplifier-bundle-stories, commit 8cadef768e61bda01bc5ead7d30ecc90b290f3e6.
It is licensed under the accompanying Microsoft MIT license. Its metrics and
capabilities are sample content, not current factual assertions about Stories.
Use it to exercise real HTML import, isolation, slide navigation, annotations and
byte-preserving export. Do not use it as an oracle for product scope or source truth.

`case-study-building-stories.md` and `metrics-analysis.md` are historical source
examples from that same upstream commit, used by `tests/evaluate_quality.py`.
Their claims are inputs to evaluate, not independently verified truth. Live evaluation
checks requested slide count and retained date/count separately from model judgments.

Storytelling evaluation also uses `blog-stories-launch.md` and
`community-announcement.md` copied verbatim from that revision's `docs/`.
`bundle-development-log.txt` is the six-entry `git log` at that revision
(short SHA, ISO date, subject); it supplies development activity, not a release tag
or verified user impact. Microsoft material remains under MICROSOFT-LICENSE.
`tests/evaluate_storytelling.py` defines bounded tasks and narrow checks separately
from these historical, sometimes contradictory or promotional example sources.
